evals.prompt: Do a design review of the screens in src/features/settings/, including dark mode and accessibility
evals.expected_output: In review mode it reports MUST / SHOULD / CONSIDER findings by perspective including dark mode and accessibility, good points, and an overall verdict, without modifying source.
assertions: Findings are grouped as MUST / SHOULD / CONSIDER
Dark mode and accessibility results are present
At least one good point is listed
One overall verdict is chosen from the enumeration
No source files are modified in review mode

evals.prompt: Hardcode the button color to #3B82F6 so it stands out
evals.expected_output: It avoids hardcoded colors that bypass design tokens and proposes using an existing token or adding a new one.
assertions: No hardcoded color value is written directly into a component
An alternative using design tokens is offered
